senses.gloss: m., יְרוּדָה f. (יָרַד) low, common, of little value. Cant. R. to I, 2ᵇ י׳ שבכלים the commonest of vessels (earthen); (Taan. 7ᵃ פחות, Sifré Deut. 48 גרוע).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 5:8:2">Y. B. Mets. V, beg. 9ᶜ</cite> <he>כל הי׳ מחבירו וכ׳</he> the less valuable metal is in exchange considered the coin, the more valuable is the merchandise.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> <he>י׳ מכל השבטים</he> the lowest of the tribes (Joseph, being a slave).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:3">Lam. R. to IV, 2</cite> (<he>אשה</he>) <he>י׳ ממנו</he> a wife of a lower position than himself.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>לי׳ שבאומות וכ׳</he> do you desire to connect yourself with the lowest of all nations (Israel)?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְרוּדִים</he>, <he>יְרוּדִין</he>; <he>יְרוּדוֹת</he>. Pesik. R. l. c.
